children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 2, 2026) - Quintessence Wealth ("
QW
") announces that Quintessence Wealth Signature IQ Asset Allocation Fund (the "
Fund
"), an investment fund managed by QW, has sold 12,502,222 common shares ("
Shares
") and an aggregate of 5,500,000 common share purchase warrants ("
Warrants
") of DelphX Capital Markets Inc.
(the "
Issuer
") to John Lunz pursuant to a private transaction (the "
Transaction
"). The Warrants consist of 2,500,000 Warrants exercisable at $0.07 per Share until December 1, 2027 and 3,000,000 Warrants exercisable at $0.08 per Share until March 24, 2030.

The aggregate purchase price for the Shares and Warrants was $826,708.60, equal to the Fund's book value of the Shares. The Transaction was completed pursuant to a share purchase agreement between the Fund and Mr. Lunz. Following the Transaction, an aggregate of 31,308,350 Shares and 5,500,000 Warrants (including those that were the subject of the Transaction) moved from managed to self-directed by the purchaser, such that QW no longer exercises control or direction over these securities. The Transfer did not involve monetary consideration (the "
Transfer

Immediately prior to the Transaction and taking into account the deposit of a Direct Registration Statement representing 543,428 Shares by a client of QW, QW exercised control or direction over managed accounts and investment pools holding 38,123,066 Shares and 14,502,222 Warrants representing approximately 15.88% of the issued and outstanding Shares on an undiluted basis (20.67% on a partially diluted basis), based on 240,060,183 issued and outstanding Shares.

Following the Transaction and the Transfer, QW exercises control or direction over managed accounts and investment pools holding 6,814,716 Shares and 9,002,222 Warrants representing approximately 2.84% of the issued and outstanding Shares on an undiluted basis (6.35% on a partially diluted basis). This represents a decrease of QW's partially diluted position by approximately 14.32%.

QW has no current plan or proposal which relates to, or would result in, acquiring additional ownership or control over the securities of the Issuer. QW may or may not purchase or sell securities of the Issuer in the future on the open market or in private transactions, depending on market conditions and other factors material to QW's investment decisions on behalf of accounts and/or pooled funds managed by QW.

A copy of QW's early warning report related to the sale of Shares and Warrants to Mr. Lunz will be filed on the Issuer's profile on SEDAR+. QW has also filed a report to correct some entries from the previous report filed by QW reflecting some additional deposits of securities of the Issuer into QW's accounts for no consideration.
A copy of the reports may be obtained upon request by contacting Stephen Gasparek at QW at 1-833-QWEALTH (793-2584), or at 5160 Yonge Street, Suite 1860, Toronto, Ontario M2N 6L9.
The Issuer's head office is located at 15 Prince Arthur Avenue, Toronto, Ontario, M5R 1B2.

title: Quintessence Wealth Announces Sale of Securities of DelphX Capital Markets Inc.
